scope: DVR file browsing/playback/download documentation. Static firmware analysis plus synthetic client playback. No real footage or hotspot credentials published. Real instrument playback/download remains unaccepted.

evidence.limitations: Configuration is static evidence, not a current live endpoint probe. No hotspot SSID/password included.

facts: Header Content-Type containing case-sensitive application/json selects JSON command handling; non-JSON requests select file handling.
POST / is the existing client form; this service does not enforce POST/root exclusively.
VIDEO.DATE normally emits METHOD, code, dateList, previewType. front maps to 1, rear to 2.
Selected empty data source returns -1; helper success returns 0.
Dates use device localtime and YYYY-MM-DD. Output ordering must not be generalized to all camera combinations.
A pre-command state gate emits code 5; its exact business meaning is unknown.
index is a zero-based page number; num is a JSON integer count.
asc start=p*k, last=min(p*k+k-1,N-1); des start=N-1-p*k, last=max(N-1-p*k-k+1,0).
sort accepts only asc/des; an unknown sort can fail to advance the index for a nonempty list.
Integer overflow and nonpositive page size are not defended by this firmware branch. Client bounds are implementation policy.
Literal string NULL disables hour filtering; JSON null/empty/omitted time do not mean the same thing.
Other time strings are split by hyphen and matched against unpadded hour strings (8-9 means hour 8 OR 9, not an interval).
Normal response writes code=0 even if helper yields no matching entries; no total/hasMore/date/index echo confirmed.
asc/des traverse the helper list; do not promise globally timestamp-sorted cross-camera results.

evidence.topic: Record metadata and media URL construction

record_fields.duration: JSON number, raw integer seconds metadata
record_fields.exigency: JSON string false, fixed by this list branch
record_fields.id: JSON number, also used as device time_t input to localtime
record_fields.name: JSON string from file record
record_fields.playUrl: host:port plus media path; no http:// in current configured form
record_fields.size: JSON signed integer, bytes through 32-bit storage
record_fields.thumbUrl: remove final four filename bytes, append .jpg under OnePicture directory
record_fields.title: HH:mm device local time

evidence.limitations: URI generation does not prove the referenced file/JPEG exists. Keep media path opaque; no universal filename pattern is specified.

evidence.topic: HTTP media and Range implementation limits
facts: MP4 MIME is video/mp4 with Accept-Ranges: bytes. File missing/unreadable branches return 404/403.
No-range path sets whole-file Content-Length and reads file data.
Range parsing uses fixed header substring/split and signed integer conversion; it is not a full RFC parser.
End value 0 is treated like omitted end; bytes=0-0 is not a reliable one-byte probe.

Limited-end loop can continue after the last intended chunk until EOF/connection loss, producing more body bytes than declared. This was checked in original AArch64 instructions, not just decompiler output.
Range handling is after a cache-hit branch.
HEAD body suppression, suffix/multipart ranges, If-Range and large offsets were not verified.
416 formatting and requested-end clamping are not reliably standards-compliant.
evidence.limitations: A 206 branch and normal local replay do not establish real-vehicle player/seek/resume compatibility.

evidence.topic: Client bug reproduction and playback verification
facts: Old client parsed scheme-less host:port URL as nil and disabled list button.
Normalization fixes this for the known instrument HTTP authorities.
Synthetic local H264 MP4 decoded to 640x360 with the real Swift AVPlayer playback code on both local and remote Mac.
Local replay observed GET bytes=0-1 -> 206 (2 bytes), then GET bytes=0-17071 -> 206 (17072 bytes).
evidence.user_report: Real instrument recording list can be fetched. No confirmation of fixed real instrument playback/download received.

facts: Client accepts supported WIFI: QR fields S/P/T and handles backslash escapes.
Saved credentials/configuration acceptance do not establish file-service reachability.
evidence.limitations: This is a known client format, not proof all projection QR payloads or signing teams support automatic joining. No credentials included.

facts: size comes from QFile::size(), stored in a 32-bit slot and serialized as JSON int; bytes, not KB/MB.
duration parses FFmpeg Duration hours:minutes:seconds.fraction, drops the fraction and computes minutes*60+hours*360+seconds.
Do not use the defective duration field instead of decoded media duration, or the 32-bit size as an integrity checksum.
